title: PyTorch
description: The official PyTorch Brand Guidelines on pytorch.org define the primary Orange (#DE3412) with Orange Light 1 (#F05F42) and Orange Light 2 (#F2765D), the secondary colours Crimson (#E12353), Raspberry (#CC2F90), Fuchsia (#CC2FAA), Violet (#B932CC) and Indigo (#812CE5), and the greys Dark Gray (#262626), Medium Gray (#666666), Light Gray (#BBBBBB), Light Light Gray (#E6E6E6), Super Light Gray (#F6F6F6) and White (#FFFFFF).
